title: Binance VIP Loan Supports Collateral Asset Adjustments and Repayment with Collateral Accounts (2025-01-20)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To enhance user experience,  Binance VIP Loan  now offers the option to repay loan orders using  collateral accounts . Users can choose to repay their VIP Loan with the same borrowed asset type from either the receiving account or the collateral accounts.  Additionally, users can now adjust their Binance VIP Loan collateral accounts and collateral asset types on the  Binance VIP Loan webpage . The adjusted collateral account and collateral asset types must meet the  initial loan-to-value requirement . Please Note: Users may access the upgraded repayment function via the  Binance VIP Loan webpage . This function is  not  supported by SAPI. Users can make repayment with different collateral accounts respectively. Each repayment can be made with one account at a time. When making repayments, the repayment amount will first be applied to loan interests, then the borrowed amount.  Users may refer to  Loan Data  for the latest interest rates and a complete list of loanable and collateral assets. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. About Binance VIP Loan:   Binance VIP Loan is an institutional-level loan service available exclusively to Binance VIP clients, providing competitive rates, terms, and delayed liquidation services. Both flexible and fixed rates are available in VIP Loan. Clients can aggregate assets across accounts as collateral to enhance capital efficiency for objectives such as greater liquidity for long-term investment funds, leveraged trading, and hedging strategies. Get Started With VIP Loan For More Information:  What Is Binance VIP Loan and Frequently Asked Questions Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-01-20
